== Card credits ==
The printed credit lines of 3 [[Players Committee]] [[Virtual cards|Virtual card]]s name Tom Frafjord (3 original concept credits).<ref name="labels">[https://github.com/billbisco/swccg-gemp/blob/0bc4377d9dd48a100625e0ec75de6032d2ea92a1/src/gemp-swccg-cards/src/main/resources/card_labels.json card_labels.json] in billbisco/swccg-gemp (commit 0bc4377d9): the printed labels of every Players Committee Virtual card, transcribed from the PC's card images. Field definitions: [https://github.com/billbisco/swccg-gemp/blob/0bc4377d9dd48a100625e0ec75de6032d2ea92a1/docs/card_labels.md docs/card_labels.md].</ref> The credited cards are in [[Virtual Block 6]] and [[Virtual Block 7]], sets dated 2009–2010 on this wiki. The events named in the concept credits date from 2008 to 2009. The concept credits also name the event or award the concept came from: Rosemount Championship 2009 (1 card); Rosemount Championship 2008 (1 card); ND States 2009 (1 card). The full list of everyone credited is at [[Card Credits#Tom Frafjord|Card Credits]].
